# Relation types

A relation is stored once, on the element it leaves, under `rel` (or implied by a structured block or reference field). The inverse is derived. **Impact** reads: how strongly the target is affected when the source changes / how strongly the source is affected when the target changes. `strong` means must be reviewed, `weak` should be reviewed.

Impact walks follow strong edges up to 2 hops and weak edges up to 1. The spine carries impact too: a change flows strong from an element to what is anchored on it, and weak the other way.

| Relation | Read backwards | Allowed | Attributes | Impact | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `serves` | `served_by` | `CAP`, `FEAT` → `OBJ`, `OPP`<br>`OPP` → `OBJ` |  | none / weak | The source exists to achieve or address the target: a capability or feature serves an objective or an opportunity. |
| `derives_from` | `source_of` | `REQ`, `RULE` → `DEC`, `PRIN`, `EVD`, `REQ`, `OPP` |  | none / strong | The source follows from a decision, a principle, a finding or another requirement. Records where a rule or requirement came from. |
| `evidenced_by` | `evidence_for` | `OBJ`, `OPP`, `SEG`, `PERS`, `ALT`, `ASM`, `DEC`, `RISK` → `EVD` |  | none / weak | The source is backed by the target evidence record. |
| `experienced_by` | `experiences` | `OPP` → `PERS`, `SEG` |  | none / weak | The opportunity is felt by the target persona or segment. |
| `alternative_for` | `has_alternative` | `ALT` → `PROD`, `OPP` |  | none / weak | The alternative is what people use today instead of the product as a whole, or for one opportunity. |
| `measured_by` | `measures` | `OBJ`, `CAP`, `FEAT` → `MET` |  | none / weak | How we know the source is working: an objective, capability or feature is judged by a metric. |
| `sourced_from` | `source_for` | `MET` → `EVT`, `ENT` |  | none / strong | A metric is computed from these events or entities. |
| `audience` | `audience_of` | `CAP`, `FEAT`, `FLW`, `SRF`, `UC`, `JRN`, `MSG`, `API` → `ACT`, `ROLE`, `PERS` | `primary` | none / weak | Who the source is for: the actor, role or persona that uses a feature, reads a message or walks a journey. |
| `represents` | `represented_by` | `PERS` → `SEG`, `ACT` |  | none / weak | A persona stands for a customer segment or an actor type. |
| `holds` | `held_by` | `ACT` → `ROLE` |  | none / weak | The actor typically holds the role. |
| `grants` | `granted_by` | `ROLE` → `PERM`<br>`PLAN` → `ENTL` | `condition`, `value` | none / strong | A role grants a permission, or a plan grants an entitlement. |

| `gated_by` | `gates` | `CAP`, `FEAT`, `API`, `SCR` → `ENTL` |  | none / strong | The source is only available when the plan grants the entitlement. |

| `realizes` | `realized_by` | `FLW` → `UC`<br>`SYS` → `DOM`, `CAP`, `FEAT` |  | weak / strong | A flow realises a use case, or a system component implements a domain, capability or feature. |
| `exposed_via` | `exposes` | `CAP`, `FEAT` → `API` |  | strong / weak | The capability or feature is available through this programmatic interface. |
| `on_surface` | `hosts` | `SCR`, `FEAT`, `MSG` → `SRF` |  | none / weak | The screen, feature or message lives on this surface. |
| `accesses` | `accessed_by` | `CAP`, `FEAT`, `FLW`, `API`, `INT` → `ENT` | `ops` | weak / strong | The source creates, reads, updates or deletes the entity. |
| `associates` | `associated_with` | `ENT` → `ENT` | `kind`, `label`, `owns` | weak / weak | One entity relates to another, with a cardinality. |
| `emits` | `emitted_by` | `CAP`, `FEAT`, `FLW`, `STM`, `API`, `INT`, `SYS` → `EVT` |  | weak / strong | The source produces the event. |
| `consumes` | `consumed_by` | `FEAT`, `FLW`, `INT`, `MSG`, `SYS` → `EVT` |  | none / strong | The source reacts to the event. |
| `integrates_with` | `integrated_by` | `INT` → `EXT` |  | none / strong | The integration connects the product to the external system. |
| `includes` | `included_in` | `RLS` → `CAP`, `FEAT`, `REQ`, `RULE`, `FLW`, `SCR`, `MSG`, `ENT`, `API`, `PLAN`, `ENTL`, `TST`, `RUN` | `note` | none / weak | The release ships this element. Release scope is listed here and nowhere else. |

| `touches` | `touched_by` | `FLW`, `JRN` → `SCR`, `MSG`, `SRF`, `API`, `EXT` | `stage` | none / weak | The flow or journey meets the person or system at this touchpoint: a screen, a message, a surface, an API or an external system. |
